- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
ChatterBot is a conversational dialog engine that generates responses
from a corpus of known conversations. It is language independent: the
engine selects a response by searching the closest matching known
statement, so it can be trained on any language. Storage adapters cover
SQL and MongoDB backends, and logic adapters can be combined or replaced
to control how responses are chosen.
about.summary: ChatterBot is a machine learning, conversational dialog engine

name: chatterbot
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.2.16"

package:
  name: chatterbot
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/c/chatterbot/chatterbot-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3066b6479a691fafcc3c359767c25102c3edce883c6d7fe56fd4e98085cb825a

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }},<3.15
    - mathparse >=0.2,<0.3
    - python-dateutil >=2.9,<2.10
    - sqlalchemy >=2.0,<2.1
    - spacy >=3.8,<3.9
    - tqdm

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - chatterbot
        - chatterbot.logic
        - chatterbot.storage
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  # Upstream tests from the sdist. The sdist ships only part of the suite
  # (tests/base_case.py is missing), so this runs the self-contained files.
  # test_corpus and test_examples need the chatterbot-corpus data and the
  # examples/ dir, and the german tagging test needs the de spacy model.
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - pytest
        - spacy-model-en_core_web_sm
    script:
      - pytest -v tests/test_cli.py tests/test_comparisons.py tests/test_languages.py tests/test_turing.py tests/test_parsing.py tests/test_tagging.py -k "not german"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/gunthercox/ChatterBot
  repository: https://github.com/gunthercox/ChatterBot
  documentation: https://docs.chatterbot.us
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: ChatterBot is a machine learning, conversational dialog engine
  description: |
    ChatterBot is a conversational dialog engine that generates responses
    from a corpus of known conversations. It is language independent: the
    engine selects a response by searching the closest matching known
    statement, so it can be trained on any language. Storage adapters cover
    SQL and MongoDB backends, and logic adapters can be combined or replaced
    to control how responses are chosen.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - killua156
